notablePrerequisites: Infinite Reflection attached to Cavalier of Dawn.
description:
Cast Herbal Poultice by paying {0}.
Herbal Poultice enters the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Dawn.
Copy of Cavalier of Dawn enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, destroying itself and creating you a 3/3 Golem token.
Copy of Cavalier of Dawn dies, triggering itself, returning Herbal Poultice from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
